policy.existing_rows: only date_published (wiki wins when it differs, compared at the wiki date precision) and format (additive ordered union)
policy.isbn: no wiki ISBN is added or merged; only conflict fixes (an ISBN the wiki assigns to a different book is replaced by the holder row’s own wiki ISBN; primary_isbn follows)
policy.inserts: NEW rows minus excluded titles; plain insert (never upsert); type from the Canon bucket or OL/GB evidence, else needs_type
policy.covers: Open Library / Google Books by ISBN only — never the wiki image (publisher copyright); a cover built from a misfiled ISBN is rebuilt from the corrected ISBN via Open Library (cover_image only), else flagged
policy.publisher: inserts: a run-together multi-imprint value keeps the chosen (US/primary) imprint; a spelling/punctuation variant of an existing catalog publisher takes the catalog spelling; distinct imprints are never merged
policy.exclusions: explicit title list plus any wiki page carrying {{Canceled}} (never-published works are not inserted)
policy.synopsis: inserts get synopsis null — catalog synopses are hand-written one-liners; wiki prose is CC BY-SA and publisher blurbs are not terse
